source.state: Local uncommitted template changes; no promotion or dealer deployment

preview.runtime: Existing Import dev server; no replacement preview or dependency installation

change: Mobile detail panel and image use one native page scroll with the existing rounded panel composition.
Utility controls stay fixed; the panel grip crossing them activates an opaque compact header.
Info, Specs and Extras stick beneath the utility row, including the safe-area inset.
Pinned tab selection starts new content directly below the tab row.
Gallery and enquiry remain separate overlays; the page panel has no nested scroller.
The grip supports free pointer dragging up/down and stays where released. Lowering reveals more of the existing photo frame; raising uses the same native page scroll.
The grip retains its painted position inside a 44px target. Keyboard positioning, cancellation and resize limits use the same bounds; BG/EN instructions live in the content boundary.
reference: Reviewed the existing templates/mobile detail screen and its running preview; no changes to that template.

freeDrag.input: Native in-app browser drag from the grip down by 90px
freeDrag.result: Position retained after release; no snapping, accidental gallery opening or pointer focus outline.

desktop.result: Visually preserved. The mobile composition and its CSS remain restricted to the phone breakpoint.

coverage: Wheel over the content scrolls the page and pins the tabs.
All utility controls remain visible with 44px tap areas.
Each tab and keyboard selection stays aligned beneath the header.
Returning to the top restores the image header.
Gallery and enquiry opening, Escape closing and focus restoration.
Real Chromium touch input freely lowers/raises the grip; position persists after a 650ms release window.
The grip has a 44px target; native content scroll continues after dragging.
Touch cancellation clears the drag session; pointer gestures do not steal keyboard focus.
Keyboard Up/Down/Home/End position the panel, and a 390x320 resize keeps the tabs visible.
